event_coordinate_scope: Absolute callback availability retained. Source-relative availability is new available_samples minus 24000; preserve negative values. Decoder frames/centers remain stream absolute coordinates. Not acoustic word-end latency.

frontend.reset: frontend, model cache, decoder beams and clocks before every clip
frontend.short_tail: actual retained samples, no padding or EOF flush

leading_context.interpretation: Changes frontend, model and decoder history. First speech-containing selected splice can be center147 with support23200..24239, including 240 original samples; no model-only intervention or acoustic onset claim.
leading_context.selection: Architecture-only: max model causal lag 44 selected rows; four complete feeds give 39 selected rows, five give 49. Smallest whole 4800-sample feed count covering the lag. No output-based choice or duration sweep.

native_timing_scope: Post-GO after dynamic loading through before final record; includes payload initialization and earlier trace output. Feed/finish times include callbacks. Unpaced audio.
resource_scope: Local one-process CPU/RSS observations; no embedded-board qualification or continuous-lifetime/child-absence proof

saved_analysis.single_clip_context_result: CONTEXT_UNVERIFIED: both positive and negative recordings required; no matched-context or panel qualification asserted

source_scope: One complete human-confirmed N1 source, 你好小窝，屋里有人; expected K1 once, no K2. Human punctuation is not acoustic alignment. Whole raw source PCM preserved.
